"""
import json
import os
import sys
import time
import numpy as np

from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

OUT = "/app/output"
CAMERAS = ["forward", "left", "right", "wrist"]
DT = 0.1

def connect():
    robot = Robot()
    print(json.dumps({"spec": robot.spec(), "status": robot.status()}, indent=2))

def observe(robot, seconds=0.0, cameras=CAMERAS, depth=False):
    return robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, seconds=seconds,

                        video="none", note=note)

def main():
    robot = connect()
    obs = observe(robot)

"""Live visual controller for VLABench select_chemistry_tube (one episode)."""
import json, os, sys, time
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

OUT = "/app/output"
DT = 0.1
LIMITS = np.array([[-2.8973,2.8973],[-1.7628,1.7628],[-2.8973,2.8973],[-3.0718,-0.0698],[-2.8973,2.8973],[-0.0175,3.7525],[-2.8973,2.8973]])

def qfrom(meta):
    return np.asarray(meta["proprio"]["now"], float)

def quat_mul(a,b):
    w,x,y,z=a; W,X,Y,Z=b
    return np.array([w*W-x*X-y*Y-z*Z, w*X+x*W+y*Z-z*Y,
                     w*Y-x*Z+y*W+z*X, w*Z+x*Y-y*X+z*W])

def quat_conj(q): return np.array([q[0],-q[1],-q[2],-q[3]])

def quat_log(q):
    if q[0] < 0: q=-q
    v=q[1:]; n=np.linalg.norm(v)
    if n < 1e-10: return 2*v
    return 2*np.arctan2(n,q[0])*v/n

class Arm:
    def __init__(self):
        self.r=Robot()
        self.layout=self.r.spec()["proprio_layout"]
        self.idx={k:i for i,k in enumerate(self.layout)}
        print("SPEC",json.dumps(self.r.spec(),indent=2))
        print("STATUS",json.dumps(self.r.status(),indent=2))
    def obs(self,cameras=("forward","left","right","wrist"),depth=True):
        return self.r.get_obs(cameras=list(cameras),include_depth=depth,video="frames")
    def run(self,q,steps,note):
        q=np.asarray(q,float).copy()
        q[:7]=np.clip(q[:7],LIMITS[:,0]+1e-4,LIMITS[:,1]-1e-4)
        q[7:]=np.clip(q[7:],0,.04)
        arr=np.tile(q,(steps,1))
        res=self.r.submit("joint_position",arr,dt=DT,interpolate="hold",cameras=None,video="none",note=note)
        return qfrom(res.meta),res.meta
    def state(self):
        o=self.r.get_obs(cameras=[],video="none")
        return qfrom(o.meta)
    def calibrate(self,delta=.045,steps=5):
        base=self.state(); q0=base[:7].copy(); p0=base[16:19].copy(); rot0=base[19:23].copy()
        J=np.zeros((6,7)); records=[]
        for j in range(7):
            target=base.copy(); target[j]+=delta
            measured,meta=self.run(target,steps,f"kinematic probe joint {j+1}")
            dq=measured[j]-q0[j]
            p=measured[16:19]; rot=measured[19:23]
            if abs(dq)>1e-5:
                J[:3,j]=(p-p0)/dq
                J[3:,j]=quat_log(quat_mul(rot,quat_conj(rot0)))/dq
            records.append({"joint":j+1,"dq":float(dq),"tcp":p.tolist(),"quat":rot.tolist(),"Jcol":J[:,j].tolist(),"meta":meta})
            self.run(base,steps,f"return from probe joint {j+1}")
            base=self.state(); q0=base[:7].copy();p0=base[16:19].copy();rot0=base[19:23].copy()
        os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
        with open(os.path.join(OUT,"jacobian_calibration.json"),"w") as f:
            json.dump({"base":base.tolist(),"jacobian":J.tolist(),"records":records},f,indent=2)
        print("CALIBRATION_BASE",base.tolist())
        print("JACOBIAN",J.tolist())
        print("SINGULAR",np.linalg.svd(J,compute_uv=False).tolist())
        return base,J

def main():
    arm=Arm()
    obs=arm.obs()
    obs.save(os.path.join(OUT,"initial_observation"))
    print("Initial state saved; invoke calibrate() before target approach.")

if __name__=="__main__": main()

        C=M[:3,3]; P=np.eye(3)-np.outer(ray,ray)
